title: Posture: How Many Inches Slouching Hides
character: Flat 2D vector character model sheet of a friendly young man standing in a front pose on a plain white background, wearing a mint-green t-shirt, dark charcoal pants, and black sneakers. Minimalist clean vector art style, simple geometric anatomy, soft flat lighting, no harsh gradients, cheerful and approachable expression.

scenes.vo: Have you ever wondered how much height slouching hides?

figures.pose: Young man standing upright, slight curious head tilt with one hand scratching his chin, mint-green tee and dark trousers.

scenes.vo: Slouching can actually hide one to two whole inches.

figures.pose: Young man visibly hunching his shoulders forward, curved upper back, dropping down in height with a disappointed face.
figures.label: Slouched

icons.prompt: Flat 2D icon of a downward red measuring tape arrow
icons.label: -2 Inches

scenes.vo: Looking down at your phone strains your neck badly.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical anatomical visualization of a human cervical spine bending forward under extreme pressure, glowing stress points along the neck vertebrae on a dark clinical background, no text.

scenes.vo: The lower you bend, the heavier your head gets.

figures.pose: Young man bending his neck deeply over a smartphone, wincing in discomfort with curved upper spine.

icons.prompt: Flat vector icon of a heavy dumbbell pressing down
icons.label: 60 lbs Strain

scenes.vo: Standing tall aligns your ears, shoulders, and hips.

figures.pose: Young man standing in perfect posture from a side-angled front view, head high, shoulders back, aligned vertically.
figures.label: Aligned

icons.prompt: Flat vector icon of vertical alignment guide dots and a plumb line
icons.label: Posture

scenes.vo: Strengthening your core and back makes standing tall effortless.

figures.pose: Young man flexing his torso confidently, smiling proudly with confident athletic stance.

icons.prompt: Flat 2D icon of a strong torso core shield with a checkmark
icons.label: Core

icons.prompt: Flat 2D icon of strong upper back muscles
icons.label: Back

scenes.vo: It unlocks your true height without lengthening any bones.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical render of a human spine gently decompressing to its natural elongated curve with soft blue energy flowing vertically, against a dark studio background, no text.

scenes.vo: Good posture simply reveals every inch you already have.

figures.pose: Slouched version of the young man in a muted grey tee standing slightly bent.
figures.label: Before

figures.pose: Upright version of the young man in mint-green tee standing tall and proud beside him.
figures.label: After

scenes.vo: So how much taller could your posture make you?

figures.pose: Young man pointing directly forward at the camera with an encouraging smile and straight spine.

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Young man holding up an iPhone displaying a green growth chart screen, waving happily.

icons.prompt: Flat vector app icon with a rising height graph and laurel badge
icons.label: TallPlan
